name: LBS Bina Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团在物业开发板块推进两项企业交易：Sinar Restu Sdn Bhd 与 Asiana Square Sdn Bhd 的买卖协议完成期限获延长8个月至2027年5月7日；Casa Inspirasi Sdn Bhd 与 Majlis Daerah Cameron Highlands 的合资协议合规期延长至2027年6月30日。此外，集团宣布派发2026年首次中期单层股息0.85仙及2025财年末期单层股息2.00仙。
overview_en: In 2026, the Group progressed two corporate transactions in the property development segment: the sale and purchase agreement between Sinar Restu Sdn Bhd and Asiana Square Sdn Bhd had its completion period extended by 8 months to 7 May 2027, and the joint venture agreement between Casa Inspirasi Sdn Bhd and Majlis Daerah Cameron Highlands had its compliance period extended to 30 June 2027.

segments.name: 物业开发
segments.note: 今年主要处理两项企业交易的期限延长，未公布新项目推出。
segments.note_en: This year mainly involved extensions of timelines for two corporate transactions, with no new project launches announced.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将上述买卖协议的完成期限延长8个月，从原定的2026年9月7日延至2027年5月7日。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to extend the completion period of the above sale and purchase agreement by 8 months, from the original date of 7 September 2026 to 7 May 2027.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Casa Inspirasi Sdn Bhd 与 Majlis Daerah Cameron Highlands 的合资协议合规期进一步延长至2027年6月30日，以履行先决条件。
actions.text_en: The compliance period for the joint venture agreement between Casa Inspirasi Sdn Bhd and Majlis Daerah Cameron Highlands was further extended to 30 June 2027 for the fulfilment of conditions precedent.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Sinar Restu Sdn Bhd 与 Asiana Square Sdn Bhd 的买卖协议已取得地方政府转让同意，买方须于2026年9月7日或之前支付余款。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement between Sinar Restu Sdn Bhd and Asiana Square Sdn Bhd obtained local authority consent to transfer, with the purchaser required to pay the balance purchase price on or before 7 September 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年宣布派发中期及末期单层股息。
segments.note_en: Declared interim and final single-tier dividends this year.

actions.title: LBS - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布2026年首次中期单层股息0.85仙，除权日为2026年4月29日，派发日为2026年5月20日。
actions.text_en: Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 0.85 sen for 2026, with ex-date on 29 April 2026 and payment date on 20 May 2026.

actions.title: LBS - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布2025财年末期单层股息2.00仙，除权日为2026年8月27日，派发日为2026年9月17日，须经股东批准。
actions.text_en: Declared a final single-tier dividend of 2.00 sen for FY2025, with ex-date on 27 August 2026 and payment date on 17 September 2026, subject to shareholders' approval.
